book.title: Groin Pain in Athletes (Adductor-related, Inguinal-related and Pubic-related)

blocks.text: Groin pain is common in sports with kicking, sprinting and change of direction (football, cricket fielding, hockey). The Doha agreement classified athletic groin pain into clinical entities [Ref – to verify]:

rows: Medial thigh near the pubic bone
Adductor tenderness and pain on resisted adduction
Pain on resisted hip flexion, psoas stretch
Pain with coughing, sit-up, no palpable hernia

blocks.text: Adductor-related groin pain is the most common [Ref – to verify].

sections.title: B to C. Presentation and questions

rows: Where exactly? Point with one finger
Deep groin clicking, catching, pain with sitting?

sections.title: D to E. Examination and tests

rows: Adductor squeeze test (long lever or 45 degrees hip flexion)
Supine; examiner's fist between knees; patient squeezes maximally
Familiar groin pain; reduced force (can measure with a sphygmomanometer or dynamometer)
Adductor-related pain and a measurable baseline
Palpate adductor longus at the pubic attachment
Resisted hip flexion and Thomas test
Hip flexed 90, adducted and internally rotated

blocks.text: Record HAGOS questionnaire scores [Ref – to verify].

rows: Runner, pain with impact, hop test painful, night pain

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Groin pain with pain on hopping in an endurance athlete or female athlete with low energy availability
Fever, severe pain on any hip movement
Child or adolescent with groin or knee pain and limp

steps: **Exclude stress fracture, hernia and medical causes.**
**Locate the entity using palpation and resisted tests.**

blocks.text: Manual therapy has a minor role (soft-tissue work for comfort). Exercise is the core:

rows: Copenhagen adduction (short lever on knee, progress to long lever on ankle)
2 to 3 × 6 to 10 per side, 2 to 3 times a week

blocks.text: The Copenhagen adduction exercise has been shown to reduce groin problems in football as a prevention program [Ref – to verify]. Active strengthening programs have stronger support than passive treatment [Ref – to verify].
Squeeze test pain and force (as a percentage of the other side or previous value), HAGOS, sport-specific tasks.

items: **Why measure squeeze force?** It gives an objective baseline and return-to-sport marker.
**A runner has groin pain on hopping. What do you suspect?** Femoral neck stress fracture.
**What is the key prevention exercise?** Copenhagen adduction.
**Pain with coughing and resisted sit-up, no adductor signs?** Inguinal-related groin pain.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Classify groin pain using the Doha entities.
Perform the squeeze test and resisted tests.
Prescribe a progressive adductor program and recognise stress fracture.

sections.A: Groin pain un khelon mein aam hai jin mein kick, sprint aur direction badalna hota hai. Doha classification mein adductor, iliopsoas, inguinal aur pubic wajahein hain.
sections.B: Ek ungli se dard ki jagah dikhayein. Kick, sprint ya mudne se dard, aur kya khansi ya zor lagane se barhta hai.
sections.D: Adductor squeeze test (ghutnon ke beech mutthi daba kar) aur resisted tests se dard ki wajah dhoondein.
sections.F: Femoral neck stress fracture, hernia aur doosri medical wajahein table mein hain.
sections.G: Hop karne par dard wala endurance athlete, khaas kar kam khurak wali khatoon athlete: stress fracture ka shak, urgent refer.
sections.H: Stress fracture, hernia aur medical wajahein rule out karein, phir dabane aur resisted tests se wajah pehchanein.
sections.I: Manual therapy ka chhota kirdaar hai. Asal ilaaj exercise hai: pehle isometric adduction, phir taaqat, phir khel ki movements.
sections.K: Machines aam taur par zaroori nahi.
sections.M: Squeeze test ka dard aur force (doosri taraf ke muqable), HAGOS aur khel ki bardasht.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Sab se aam wajah adductor-related hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
